en: Help build open data for Aruban Papiamento
pap: Yuda traha dato habri pa Papiamento di Aruba

en: Prototype. Your answers stay in this browser until you export them. Nothing is sent anywhere.
pap: Prueba. Bo contestacionnan ta keda den e browser aki te ora bo exporta nan. Nos no ta manda nada.

en: The Papiamento text on these screens is a machine draft. A teacher must check it before it is used.
pap: E texto na Papiamento aki ta un concepto di mashin. Un docente mester controla prome cu nos uz'e.

en: Prototype only: add or switch people to try the tool as a second teacher or as a board member.
pap: Solamente pa e prueba: agrega of cambia persona pa purba e herment como un otro docente of como miembro di e conseho.

en: Your answers help build an open, free dataset of Aruban Papiamento. Two people answer each question, and a member of the review board checks every answer before it counts.
pap: Bo contestacionnan ta yuda traha un coleccion di dato habri y gratis di Papiamento di Aruba. Dos persona ta contesta cada pregunta, y un miembro di e conseho di revision ta controla cada contestacion prome cu e ta conta.

en: Your name, as it should appear in the list of contributors
pap: Bo nomber, manera e mester sali den e lista di hende cu a contribui

en: I am a member of the review board (prototype: switch this on to see the board screens)
pap: Mi ta miembro di e conseho di revision (prueba: marca aki pa mira e pantaya di e conseho)

en: I agree that my word translations are published under CC BY 4.0, like the rest of the dataset.
pap: Mi ta di acuerdo cu nos ta publica mi traduccion di palabra bou di CC BY 4.0, manera e resto di e dato.

en: I agree that my sentences are published under CC0 (public domain), so anyone, including Common Voice, may use them.
pap: Mi ta di acuerdo cu nos ta publica mi frasenan bou di CC0 (dominio publico), pa cualkier hende, tambe Common Voice, por uza nan.

en: Not decided yet: the licence for sentences. CC0 is the recommendation.
pap: E licencia pa frase no ta dicidi ainda. CC0 ta e recomendacion.

en: Show my name in the list of contributors.
pap: Mustra mi nomber den e lista di hende cu a contribui.

en: We keep your name and your answers. Your email address, in the real tool, is never published. In this prototype everything stays in your browser.
pap: Nos ta warda bo nomber y bo contestacionnan. Den e herment real, nos no ta publica bo email nunca. Den e prueba aki tur cos ta keda den bo browser.

en: Write your name and tick both licence boxes to start.
pap: Skirbi bo nomber y marca e dos licencianan pa cuminsa.

en: Check machine-made English, Dutch and Spanish translations against the printed AB 2018 word list.
pap: Controla traduccion na ingles, hulandes y spaño cu un mashin a traha, cu e lista di palabra di AB 2018.

en: Give English, Dutch and Spanish for words that have no translation yet.
pap: Duna ingles, hulandes y spaño pa palabra cu no tin traduccion ainda.

en: Write short everyday sentences in Aruban Papiamento.
pap: Skirbi frase cortico di tur dia na Papiamento di Aruba.

en: Read sentences other teachers wrote and say whether they are good.
pap: Lesa frase cu otro docente a skirbi y bisa si nan ta bon.

en: Confirm answers when two people agree. Decide when they do not.
pap: Confirma contestacion ora dos persona ta di acuerdo. Dicidi ora nan no ta di acuerdo.

en: Nothing more is waiting for you here. Thank you!
pap: No tin nada mas pa bo aki. Danki!
Comentario pa e conseho di revision (si bo kier)
Nos a warda bo contestacion. Danki!

en: The machine was not sure about this translation. Please check it carefully.
pap: E mashin no tabata sigur di e traduccion aki. Controla bon.

en: Is each translation right for the Aruban meaning of this word?
pap: Cada traduccion ta corecto pa e nificacion di e palabra aki na Aruba?

en: Answer all three languages, or mark them Not sure.
pap: Contesta pa tur tres idioma, of marca nan No ta sigur.

en: Write the meaning in each language. If you are not sure, leave the box empty.
pap: Skirbi e nificacion den cada idioma. Si bo no ta sigur, no skirbi nada.

en: Up to three meanings, the most common first, separated by a semicolon (;). English verbs start with "to", as in "to go".
pap: Maximo tres nificacion, esun di mas uza prome, separa cu punto y coma (;). Verbo na ingles ta cuminsa cu "to", manera "to go".
Mi no conoce e palabra aki

en: Write this sentence in Aruban Papiamento, the way you speak.
pap: Skirbi e frase aki na Papiamento di Aruba, manera bo ta papia.

en: There is no machine suggestion here on purpose: we want your own words.
pap: Nos no ta mustra un traduccion di mashin aki: nos kier bo mesun palabranan.

en: You already wrote for this sentence:
pap: Bo a skirbi caba pa e frase aki:

en: {n} other people translated this sentence. You will not see their answers, so yours stays independent.
pap: {n} otro persona a traduci e frase aki. Bo no ta mira nan contestacion, pa bo contestacion ta di bo so.
Nos no a haya ningun problema.

en: The checks can be wrong. If you are sure, keep what you wrote.
pap: E control por ta robes. Si bo ta sigur, laga loke bo a skirbi.

en: Not in the AB 2018 word list. Check the spelling (names are fine).
pap: No ta den e lista di palabra di AB 2018. Controla e ortografia (nomber ta bon).
No ta Papiamento di Aruba. Skirbi: {right}

en: Check this word. Often it should be: {right}
pap: Controla e palabra aki. Hopi biaha e mester ta: {right}

en: {n} flagged word(s) kept as written. The board will see this.
pap: {n} palabra cu e control a marca a keda manera bo a skirbi nan. E conseho lo mira esaki.

en: Is this a good Aruban Papiamento translation of the sentence?
pap: Esaki ta un bon traduccion na Papiamento di Aruba?

en: Items that two people answered independently. Confirm when they agree; decide when they differ. Only review-board members see this screen.
pap: Aki bo ta mira cos cu dos persona a contesta. Confirma ora nan ta di acuerdo; dicidi ora nan no ta di acuerdo. Solamente miembro di e conseho di revision ta mira esaki.

en: This screen is for review-board members only.
pap: E pantaya aki ta solamente pa miembro di e conseho di revision.

en: You gave one of these answers, so another board member must decide.
pap: Bo a duna un di e contestacionnan. Un otro miembro mester dicidi.

en: Nothing is waiting for the board.
pap: No tin nada cu ta warda e conseho.

en: Download everything stored in this browser as one JSON file. In the real tool this happens on the server, and a pull request is opened for the maintainers.
pap: Descarga tur loke ta warda den e browser aki como un file JSON. Den e herment real esaki ta pasa riba e server.

en: Add answers from a JSON file
pap: Agrega contestacion for di un file JSON
Kita tur cos for di e browser aki

en: Delete all people and answers stored in this browser?
pap: Kita tur persona y contestacion den e browser aki?

en: {a} word answers, {t} sentences, {r} ratings, {d} board decisions
pap: {a} contestacion di palabra, {t} frase, {r} evaluacion, {d} decision di e conseho

en: GitHub username (board members need one to approve pull requests)
pap: Nomber di GitHub (miembro di e conseho mester esaki pa aproba cambio)

en: Prototype: add a second person (top right) to rate the sentences the first person wrote.
pap: Prueba: agrega un otro persona pa evalua e frasenan cu e prome persona a skirbi.

en: Choose what to publish for each language, or write your own.
pap: Scoge loke nos ta publica pa cada idioma, of skirbi esun di bo.

en: Choose or write an answer for each line.
pap: Scoge of skirbi un contestacion pa cada liña.

en: Prototype: import another browser's export to try the two-person flow.
pap: Prueba: importa e file di un otro browser pa purba cu dos persona.

en: What the pull request would change
pap: Kico lo cambia den e dato

en: A sync job would write these rows to a branch and open a pull request. The board member named in reviewed_by approves it on GitHub; no row becomes reviewed without that.
pap: Un programa lo skirbi e liñanan aki y habri un pull request. E miembro di e conseho ta aprob'e den GitHub.

en: You're offline. Your answers stay on this device and are sent when you're back online.
pap: Bo no tin conexion. Bo contestacionnan ta keda den bo aparato y nos ta manda nan ora bo tin conexion atrobe.

en: Check and translate words from the official AB 2018 word list.
pap: Controla y traduci palabra di e lista oficial di AB 2018.

en: Write short everyday sentences in Aruban Papiamento.
pap: Skirbi frase cortico di tur dia na Papiamento di Aruba.

en: Two people answer each item, and the review board checks every answer.
pap: Dos persona ta contesta cada pregunta, y e conseho di revision ta controla cada contestacion.

en: We send you a 6-digit code. No password and no GitHub account needed.
pap: Nos ta manda bo un codigo di 6 cifra. Bo no mester un cuenta di GitHub.

en: Prototype: no email is sent and the address is not stored.
pap: Prueba: nos no ta manda email y nos no ta warda e adres.
Nos a manda un codigo di 6 cifra na {email}.

en: Prototype: the daily goal is fixed at 10 here. In the real tool each person sets their own.
pap: Prueba: e meta di cada dia ta 10 aki. Den e herment real cada persona ta scoge su meta.
Verbo na ingles ta cuminsa cu "to".

en: Separate different meanings with ; not with a comma.
pap: Separa nificacion cu ; no cu coma.

en: Mark words not in the AB 2018 list
pap: Marca palabra cu no ta den e lista di AB 2018

en: Once a second person has answered, a board member checks it.
pap: Ora un segundo persona contesta, un miembro di e conseho ta controla.

en: Two people have answered. It now goes to the review board.
pap: Dos persona a contesta. Awor e ta bay na e conseho di revision.
Un otro docente lo evalua e frase.

en: Your rating helps the board decide.
pap: Bo evaluacion ta yuda e conseho dicidi.

en: The checker found these. Use the suggestions, or keep what you wrote.
pap: E control a haya esakinan. Uza e sugerencianan, of laga loke bo a skirbi.
Laga manera e ta y warda
Tur cos ta cla pa awor
Ainda no tin frase pa evalua

en: Choose an item from the list.
pap: Scoge un cos for di e lista.

en: Choose the sentence to publish, or write your own.
pap: Scoge e frase cu nos ta publica, of skirbi esun di bo.

en: It goes into the next pull request, which you approve on GitHub.
pap: E ta bay den e siguiente pull request. Bo ta aprob'e den GitHub.

en: Listed by name, not ranked. Everyone here helped build the dataset.
pap: Pa nomber, sin rango. Tur hende aki a yuda traha e dato.
Ainda no tin hende cu a contribui.
Ainda no tin miembro di e conseho.

en: Tick both licence boxes to continue.
pap: Marca e dos licencianan pa sigui.

en: The page image did not load.
pap: E imagen di e pagina no a carga.

en: That file could not be read. Choose a JSON file exported from this tool.
pap: Nos no por a lesa e file. Scoge un file JSON di e herment aki.

en: Your answer is still here. Check your connection and try again.
pap: Bo contestacion ta keda aki. Controla bo conexion y purba atrobe.

en: We couldn't send the code. Check the address and try again.
pap: Nos no por a manda e codigo. Controla e adres y purba atrobe.

en: This browser is not saving your answers. Export them before you close this page.
pap: E browser aki no ta warda bo contestacionnan. Exporta nan prome cu bo cera e pagina aki.

en: Board members need a GitHub username (letters, digits and hyphens).
pap: Miembro di e conseho mester un nomber di GitHub.

en: Try the loading and error states: saving takes longer, or fails and offers Try again.
pap: Purba con e herment ta traha ora e conexion ta malo.
